lyrics: Gypsy woman, where have you been gone too long, don’t you know it’s a sin It’s been three nights and four more days oh you know you put me in a daze I’ve been down by the mountain side giving life to a river that died I’m a flower wild and free live my life for swaying in the breeze... Then by the fire she dances at night... her body bending bends my mind... Aye Aye Oh she makes me feel alright blinks her eyes in fireflies... I’m the fire in your eyes... the embers glowing in your mind... Aye Aye I’m the coal beneath your feet.. oh that woman got me on my knees...
